sources.filename: Data Science & AI (DSAI - K9) (Official) - Start Date_ 28_05_2026 (1).xlsx

selected_source_cells.value:
Linear Algebra:
- Scalars, vectors, matrices and operations
- Vector & matrix norms
- Special matrices & vectors
- Eigenvalues & eigentvectors
- Norms & eigen decomposition

Calculus:
- Differentiation of univariate functions
- Partial derivatives & gradients
- Integration
- Optimization

Probability & Statistics:
- Foundation of probability: probability theory & bayes theorem
- Probability distributions: normal, bernoulli, binomial, poison
- Describe the data: expectation, variance, covariance & correlation
- Statistical inference: hypothesis testing and confidence intervals

- Data types: structured vs. unstructured, qualitative vs. quantitative
- 4 levels of measurements: nominal, ordinal, interval & ratio
- The big five of feature engineering: improvement, construction, selection, extraction, representation learning
- Statistical feature evaluation metrics: correlation, mutual information and Chi-Squared tests
- ML pipelines: automation, examples & best practices
- Industrial tips

- Generative vs. discriminative classification
- Linear SVM: the large margin intuition and support vectors 
- The objective function: hinge loss, regularization and optimization
- Hard & soft margin classifications
- Kernel methods
- Nonlinear SVM: polynomial & gaussian
- Industrial tips

- Fundamentals of decision trees and feature importance.
- Insights into Random Forests.
- Dive into data drift and incremental learning techniques.

- Understand the role of hypothesis testing in data science projects. 
- Key concepts: Null hypothesis, alternative hypothesis, p-value, confidence intervals. 
- Common tests: t-test, chi-square test, ANOVA. 
- Practical considerations: sample size, Type I and Type II errors.

scope: User-provided K9 curricula used only as class-content reference. K11 final rubric remains primary. Keyword absence does not prove a technique was never taught. Original workbooks/private links/full extraction are not copied into Git.
